test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the letter-cluster among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

TRIBUTE, RBTEUIT, BEITUTR, ?, TRIBUTE
solution:
**LOGIC**: **When we go to the next word from the first word, letters in places 2, 4, and 6 are placed in starting, and letters in places 1, 3, 5, and 7 are placed at the end in reverse. we will follow this pattern in all.**

Now,

First-word → Second word

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a14de932289534477826207cbd2d5609017d78c36ae38fd4f78ecff497eca403.png] 

Second word → Third Word 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/818eff503f4bf2925cafd38298a640028dfce69257cf67f191036cadbf823c1d.png] 

Third word →** ****Fourth Word**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d04fef67030779e4e5f26844fffa21d9240646aabf61f5900ce066c611dd5a6.png] 

Forth word → Fifth word

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259813b473101d827818620dc93f4cd4efe52712eb2cdbadaa4f893bcfb09a30.png] 

Hence, The correct answer is **"ETTRUIB"**.
